c4.text: The character connected to the Jinni will obtain the following buffs based on their current HP and Energy: ['When their HP is lower than 50%, they gain 50% Incoming Healing Bonus.', 'When their Energy is less than 50%, they gain 30% Energy Recharge.']

c5.name: Value for Mora
c5.text: Increases the Level of Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Sprinkling Weight
c6.text: Dori gains the following effects for 3s after using Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon: ['Electro Infusion.', "When Normal Attacks hit opponents, all nearby party members will heal HP equivalent to 4% of Dori's Max HP. This type of healing can occur once every 0.1s."]

burst.name: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts

params.0: Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts DMG
params.1: Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder DMG

passive1.name: Light Manifest of the Divine Calculus
passive1.text: Durin will trigger different buffs depending on the form that his power manifests as when he unleashes his Elemental Burst. When that form is: Dragon of White Flame After nearby party members trigger Burning, Overloaded, Pyro Swirl, or Pyro Crystallize reactions on an opponent, or deal Pyro DMG or Dendro DMG to an opponent affected by Burning, that opponent's Pyro RES, and the RES for the corresponding Element involved in the reaction, are decreased by 20% for 6s. Dragon of Dark Decay Durin's Vaporize DMG is increased by 40% and his Melt DMG is increased by 40%.

passive2.name: Chaos Formed Like the Night
passive2.text: After unleashing an Elemental Burst, Durin gains the Primordial Fusion of Forms effect for 20s: Durin gains 10 stacks of Primordial Fusion. When a periodic attack from Dragon of White Flame or Dragon of Dark Decay deals DMG, 1 stack of Primordial Fusion will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 3% of the original DMG for every 100 ATK. A maximum of 75% additional DMG can be dealt this way. When a single attack from Dragon of White Flame or Dragon of Dark Decay hits multiple opponents, only one stack of Primordial Fusion is consumed. Primordial Fusion stacks are reset when the Elemental Burst is unleashed again.

passive3.name: Echoes of the Surging Earth
passive3.text: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Mondstadt Expedition for 20 hours.

c1.name: Adamah's Redemption
c1.text: After casting his Elemental Burst, Durin's effects will vary depending on the form of his Elemental Burst: [" Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts: All other nearby party members gain 20 stacks of Cycle of Enlightenment lasting 20s. When nearby active characters deal Normal Attack, Charged Attack, Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill, or Elemental Burst DMG, 1 stack of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 60% of Durin's ATK. Stack counts for characters in the party who have Cycle of Enlightenment are managed individually.", " Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder: Durin gains 20 stacks of Cycle of Enlightenment lasting 20s. When Durin deals Elemental Burst DMG, 2 stacks of Cycle of Enlightenment will be consumed to increase the DMG dealt by 150% of Durin's ATK."] When an Elemental Burst is used, Cycle of Enlightenment stacks will be refreshed.

c2.name: Unground Visions
c2.text: For 20s after Durin uses an Elemental Burst, after nearby party members trigger Vaporize, Melt, Burning, Overloaded, Pyro Swirl, or Pyro Crystallize reactions, or deal Pyro DMG or Dendro DMG to an opponent affected by Burning, all nearby party members gain a 50% increase to their Pyro DMG and to the corresponding elemental DMG involved in the reaction for 6s.

c3.name: Flame Mirror's Revelation
c3.text: Increases the Level of Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Emanare's Source
c4.text: Durin's Elemental Burst DMG is increased by 40%. Additionally, when effects that consume Cycle of Enlightenment stacks are triggered as part of the Constellation Adamah's Redemption, there is a 30% chance that no Cycle of Enlightenment stacks will be consumed.

c5.name: Scouring Flame's Sundering
c5.text: Increases the Level of Binary Form: Convergence and Division by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Dual Birth
c6.text: Durin's Elemental Burst DMG ignores 30% of opponents' DEF. Additionally, Durin's Elemental Bursts Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts and Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder are each enhanced: [" After Principle of Purity: As the Light Shifts and Dragon of White Flame hit an opponent, that opponent's DEF is decreased by 30% for 6s.", " DMG from Principle of Darkness: As the Stars Smolder and Dragon of Dark Decay will ignore an additional 40% of opponents' DEF."]

passive1.name: Lingering Fragrance
passive1.text: Each time it collects 2 Scents, the Level 2 Lumidouce Case will consume Scents and release Cleardew Cologne that deals AoE Dendro DMG equal to 600% of Emilie's ATK to opponents. This DMG is not considered Elemental Skill DMG.

passive2.name: Rectification
passive2.text: Emilie deals increased DMG to Burning opponents based on her ATK, with every 1,000 ATK increasing DMG dealt by 15%. The maximum DMG bonus that can be gained this way is 36%.

passive3.name: Headspace Capture
passive3.text: When the Lumidouce Case created by Emilie is on the field, all party members gain 85% Pyro RES against Burning DMG.

c1.name: Light Fragrance Leaching
c1.text: Increases the DMG dealt by Fragrance Extraction and her Ascension Talent's Cleardew Cologne "Lingering Fragrance" by 20%. The latter requires unlocking said Ascension Talent first. Additionally, when nearby party members trigger the Burning reaction on opponents or deal Dendro DMG to Burning opponents, they will generate an additional Scent. This effect can be triggered once every 2.9s.

c2.name: Lakelight Top Note
c2.text: When Fragrance Extraction, Aromatic Explication, or Cleardew Cologne produced by the Ascension Talent "Lingering Fragrance" (the last of which requires Ascension Talent activation) hits opponents, those opponents' Dendro RES is decreased by 30% for 10s.

c3.name: Exquisite Essence
c3.text: Increases the Level of Fragrance Extraction by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Lumidouce Heart Note
c4.text: Aromatic Explication's duration is increased by 2s. The interval between opponents being selected as the target for Scented Dew is decreased by 0.3s.

c5.name: Puredew Aroma
c5.text: Increases the Level of Aromatic Explication by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Marcotte Sillage
c6.text: When using Fragrance Extraction or Aromatic Explication, Emilie will gain Abiding Fragrance for 5s. While this is active, after Emilie uses Normal or Charged Attacks, she will generate 1 Scent, and her Normal and Charged Attack DMG will be converted into Dendro DMG that cannot be overridden, and the DMG dealt will be increased by 300% of Emilie's ATK. The Abiding Fragrance effect will be removed after 4 Scents are created this way or after its duration expires. Abiding Fragrance can be triggered once every 12s.

passive1.name: Better to Salivate Than Medicate
passive1.text: After using the Elemental Burst Scoring Cuts, Escoffier will obtain the Rehab Diet effect for 9s: Restores HP for nearby active characters every 1s based on 138.24% of Escoffier's ATK.

passive2.name: Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning
passive2.text: When there are 1/2/3/4 Hydro or Cryo characters in the party, Escoffier will decrease the Hydro RES and Cryo RES of any opponents hit by her Elemental Skill, Low-Temperature Cooking, or her Elemental Burst, Scoring Cuts, by 5%/10%/15%/55% for 12s.

passive3.name: Constant Off-the-Cuff Cookery
passive3.text: When using the Hold form of her Elemental Skill Low-Temperature Cooking, Escoffier will activate her All-Spectrum Multi-Use Cooking Mek in its Off-the-Cuff Cookery mode. Cooking Mek: Off-the-Cuff Cookery Mode [' Places the Cooking Mek on the field. The Cooking Mek can absorb elemental attacks. When the absorbed elemental energy hits a certain limit, Escoffier can convert the ingredients placed within it into wonderful food.', ' Escoffier needs time to purchase new ingredients, so she can only make a certain number of dishes like this each week. The number of dishes Escoffier can make resets every Monday at 4:00 AM {TIMEZONE}.']

c1.name: Pre-Dinner Dance for Your Taste Buds
c1.text: When 4 party members are Hydro or Cryo, all nearby party members will have their Cryo DMG CRIT DMG increased by 60% for 15s after Escoffier uses her Elemental Skill Low-Temperature Cooking or Elemental Burst Scoring Cuts. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Inspiration-Immersed Seasoning."

c2.name: Fresh, Fragrant Stew Is an Art
c2.text: When Escoffier activates her Cooking Mek in its Cold Storage Mode, she will gain the "Freshly-Prepped Delicacy" effect for 15s. During this time, Escoffier will gain 5 Cold Dish stacks. When nearby active characters apart from Escoffier deal Cryo DMG with a Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attack, or an Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, they will expend 1 Cold Dish stack to increase their DMG dealt by 240% of Escoffier's ATK. If you hit multiple opponents with a single instance of Cryo DMG, Cold Dish stacks will be consumed based on the number of opponents hit.

c3.name: The Bakery Magic of Caramel Browning
c3.text: Increases the Level of Low-Temperature Cooking by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Secret Rosemary Recipe
c4.text: Rehab Diet lasts 6 more seconds. While it is active, you have a chance of healing 100% extra HP and restoring 2 Energy to Escoffier when you trigger healing through Rehab Diet. This chance corresponds to Escoffier's CRIT Rate. You can trigger this effect 7 times during any one Rehab Diet's duration. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Better to Salivate Than Medicate."

c5.name: Symphony of a Thousand Sauces
c5.text: Increases the Level of Scoring Cuts by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Tea Parties Bursting With Color
c6.text: Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode is enhanced: [" When your party's active character's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode will fire off another Special-Grade Frosty Parfait, dealing 500% of Escoffier's ATK as AoE Cryo DMG. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG."] This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s, and this effect can be triggered 6 times within the duration of one Cooking Mek: Cold Storage Mode.

passive1.name: Roiling Rime
passive1.text: If 2 stacks of Grimheart are consumed upon unleashing the Holding Mode of Icetide Vortex, a Shattered Lightfall Sword will be created that will explode immediately, dealing 50% of the basic Physical DMG dealt by a Lightfall Sword created by Glacial Illumination.

passive2.name: Wellspring of War-Lust
passive2.text: When Glacial Illumination is cast, the CD of Icetide Vortex is reset and Eula gains 1 stack of Grimheart.

passive3.name: Aristocratic Introspection
passive3.text: When Eula crafts Character Talent Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

c1.name: Tidal Illusion
c1.text: Every time Icetide Vortex's Grimheart stacks are consumed, Eula's Physical DMG is increased by 30% for 6s. Each stack consumed will increase the duration of this effect by 6s up to a maximum of 18s.

c2.name: Lady of Seafoam
c2.text: Decreases the CD of Icetide Vortex's Holding Mode, rendering it identical to Press CD.

c3.name: Lawrence Pedigree
c3.text: Increases the Level of Glacial Illumination by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: The Obstinacy of One's Inferiors
c4.text: Lightfall Swords deal 25% increased DMG against opponents with less than 50% HP.

c5.name: Chivalric Quality
c5.text: Increases the Level of Icetide Vortex by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Noble Obligation
c6.text: Lightfall Swords created by Glacial Illumination start with 5 stacks of energy. Normal Attacks, Elemental Skills, and Elemental Bursts have a 50% chance to grant the Lightfall Sword an additional stack of energy.

passive1.name: Impetuous Flow
passive1.text: When Faruzan is in the Manifest Gale state created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin, the amount of time taken to charge a shot is decreased by 60%, and she can apply The Wind's Secret Ways' Perfidious Wind's Bale to opponents who are hit by the vortex created by Pressurized Collapse.

passive2.name: Lost Wisdom of the Seven Caverns
passive2.text: When characters affected by The Wind's Secret Ways' Prayerful Wind's Benefit deal Anemo DMG using Normal, Charged, Plunging Attacks, Elemental Skills, or Elemental Bursts to opponents, they will gain the Hurricane Guard effect: This DMG will be increased based on 32% of Faruzan's Base ATK. 1 instance of Hurricane Guard can occur once every 0.8s. This DMG Bonus will be cleared after Prayerful Wind's Benefit expires or after the effect is triggered once.

passive3.name: Tomes Light the Path
passive3.text: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on a Sumeru Expedition for 20 hours.

c1.name: Truth by Any Means
c1.text: Faruzan can fire off a maximum of 2 Hurricane Arrows using fully charged Aimed Shots while under the effect of a single Manifest Gale created by Wind Realm of Nasamjnin.

c2.name: Overzealous Intellect
c2.text: The duration of the Dazzling Polyhedron created by The Wind's Secret Ways is increased by 6s.

c3.name: Spirit-Orchard Stroll
c3.text: Increases the Level of Wind Realm of Nasamjnin by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Divine Comprehension
c4.text: The vortex created by Pressurized Collapses will restore Energy to Faruzan based on the number of opponents hit: If it hits 1 opponent, it will restore 2 Energy for Faruzan. Each additional opponent hit will restore 0.5 more Energy for Faruzan. A maximum of 4 Energy can be restored to her per vortex.

c5.name: Wonderland of Rumination
c5.text: Increases the Level of The Wind's Secret Ways by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: The Wondrous Path of Truth
c6.text: Characters affected by The Wind's Secret Ways' Prayerful Wind's Benefit have 40% increased CRIT DMG when they deal Anemo DMG. When the active character deals DMG while affected by Prayerful Wind's Benefit, they will apply Pressurized Collapse to the opponent damaged. This effect can be triggered once every 3s. This CD is shared between all party members.

passive1.name: Stellar Predator
passive1.text: When Fischl hits Oz with a fully-charged Aimed Shot, Oz brings down Thundering Retribution, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 152.7% of the arrow's DMG.

passive2.name: Undone Be Thy Sinful Hex
passive2.text: If your current active character triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction when Oz is on the field, the opponent shall be stricken with Thundering Retribution that deals Electro DMG equal to 80% of Fischl's ATK.

passive3.name: Mein Hausgarten
passive3.text: When dispatched on an expedition in Mondstadt, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

c1.name: Gaze of the Deep
c1.text: Even when Oz is not present in combat, he can still watch over Fischl through his raven eyes. When Fischl performs a Normal Attack against an opponent, Oz fires a coordinated attack, dealing DMG equal to 22% of Fischl's ATK.

c2.name: Devourer of All Sins
c2.text: When Nightrider is used, it deals an additional 200% ATK as DMG, and its AoE is increased by 50%.

c3.name: Wings of Nightmare
c3.text: Increases the Level of Nightrider by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Her Pilgrimage of Bleak
c4.text: When Midnight Phantasmagoria is used, it deals 222% of ATK as Electro DMG to surrounding opponents. When the skill duration ends, Fischl regenerates 20% of her HP.

c5.name: Against the Fleeing Light
c5.text: Increases the Level of Midnight Phantasmagoria by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Evernight Raven
c6.text: Extends the duration of Oz's presence on the field by 2s. Additionally, Oz performs coordinated attacks with your active character when present, dealing 30% of Fischl's ATK as Electro DMG.

passive1.name: Symphony of Winter
passive1.text: Flins will gain a corresponding buff effect based on the party's Moonsign. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: Lunar-Charged reactions triggered by Flins will deal an additional 20% DMG.

passive2.name: Whispering Flame
passive2.text: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 8% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 160.

passive3.name: Moonsign Benediction: Old World Secrets
passive3.text: When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Flins has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%. Additionally, when Flins is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

c1.name: Part the Veil of Snow
c1.text: The basic cooldown of the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm is reduced to 4s. Additionally, when party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, Flins will recover 8 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 5.5s.

c2.name: The Devil's Wall
c2.text: For the next 6s after using the special Elemental Skill Northland Spearstorm, when Flins's next Normal Attack hits an opponent, it will deal an additional 50% of Flins's ATK as AoE Electro DMG. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: While Flins is on the field, after his Electro attacks hit an opponent, that opponent's Electro RES will be decreased by 25% for 7s.

c3.name: Stranger in the Night
c3.text: Increases the Level of Ancient Ritual: Cometh the Night by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Night on Bald Mountain
c4.text: Flins's ATK is increased by 20%. Additionally, his Ascension Talent Whispering Flame is enhanced: Flins's Elemental Mastery is increased by 10% of his ATK. The maximum increase obtainable this way is 220.

c5.name: Exile's Shadow
c5.text: Increases the Level of Ancient Rite: Arcane Light by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Songs and Dances of Death
c6.text: The DMG dealt to opponents by Flins's Lunar-Charged reactions is elevated by 35%. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: All nearby party members' Lunar-Charged DMG is elevated by 10%.

passive1.name: Saturation Deep Dive
passive1.text: When Freminet unleashes Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure, if Pers Timer has yet to reach Pressure Level 4, the CD of Pressurized Floe will be decreased by 1s.

passive2.name: Parallel Condensers
passive2.text: When Freminet triggers Shatter against opponents, the DMG dealt by Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 40% for 5s.

passive3.name: Deepwater Navigation
passive3.text: Decreases Aquatic Stamina consumption for your own party members by 35%. Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

c1.name: Dreams of the Foamy Deep
c1.text: The CRIT Rate of Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will be increased by 15%.

c2.name: Penguins and the Land of Plenty
c2.text: Unleashing Pressurized Floe: Shattering Pressure will restore 2 Energy to Freminet. If a Pressure Level 4 Shattering Pressure is unleashed, this will restore 3 Energy.

c3.name: Song of the Eddies and Bleached Sands
c3.text: Increases the Level of Normal Attack: Flowing Eddies by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Dance of the Snowy Moon and Flute
c4.text: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his ATK will be increased by 9% for 6s. Max 2 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

c5.name: Nights of Hearth and Happiness
c5.text: Increases the Level of Pressurized Floe by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Moment of Waking and Resolve
c6.text: After Freminet triggers Frozen, Shatter, Superconduct, or Stellar-Conduct against opponents, his CRIT DMG will be increased by 12% for 6s. Max 3 stacks. This can be triggered once every 0.3s.

params.3: Fanfare to DMG Increase Conversion Ratio
params.4: Fanfare to Incoming Healing Bonus Conversion Ratio

passive1.name: Endless Waltz
passive1.text: When the active character in your party receives healing, if the source of the healing is not Furina herself and the healing overflows, then Furina will heal nearby party members for 2% of their Max HP once every 2s for the next 4s.

passive2.name: Unheard Confession
passive2.text: Every 1,000 points of Furina's Max HP can buff the different Arkhe-aligned Salon Solitaire in the following ways: Will increase Salon Members' DMG dealt by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 28%. Will decrease the Singer of Many Waters' healing interval for nearby active characters by 0.4%, up to a maximum of 16%.

passive3.name: The Sea Is My Stage
passive3.text: Xenochromatic Fontemer Aberrant ability CD decreased by 30%.

c1.name: "Love Is a Rebellious Bird That None Can Tame"
c1.text: When using Let the People Rejoice, Furina will gain 150 Fanfare. Additionally, Furina's Fanfare limit is increased by 100.

c2.name: "A Woman Adapts Like Duckweed in Water"
c2.text: While Let the People Rejoice lasts, Furina's Fanfare gain from increases or decreases in nearby characters' HP is increased by 250%. Each point of Fanfare above the limit will increase Furina's Max HP by 0.35%. Her maximum Max HP increase is 140%.

c3.name: "My Secret Is Hidden Within Me, No One Will Know My Name"
c3.text: Increases the Level of Let the People Rejoice by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: "They Know Not Life, Who Dwelt in the Netherworld Not!"
c4.text: When the Salon Members from Salon Solitaire hit an opponent, or the Singer of Many Waters restores HP to nearby active characters, Furina will restore 4 Energy. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

c5.name: "His Name I Now Know, It Is...!"
c5.text: Increases the Level of Salon Solitaire by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: "Hear Me — Let Us Raise the Chalice of Love!"
c6.text: When using Salon Solitaire, Furina gains "Center of Attention" for 10s. Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, and Plunging Attacks are converted into Hydro DMG which cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion. DMG is also increased by an amount equivalent to 18% of Furina's max HP. Throughout the duration, Furina's Normal Attacks (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attacks, and the impact of Plunging Attacks will cause different effects up to every 0.1s after hitting opponents depending on her current Arkhe alignment: Arkhe: Ousia Every 1s, all nearby characters in the party will be healed by 4% of Furina's max HP, for a duration of 2.9s. Triggering this effect again will extend its duration. Arkhe: Pneuma This Normal Attack (not including Arkhe: Seats Sacred and Secular Attacks), Charged Attack, or Plunging Attack ground impact DMG will be further increased by an amount equivalent to 25% of Furina's max HP. When any of the attacks mentioned previously hit an opponent, all nearby characters in the party will consume 1% of their current HP. During the duration of each instance of "Center of Attention," the above effects can be triggered up to 6 times. "Center of Attention" will end when its effects have triggered 6 times or when the duration expires.

passive1.name: Dance of Amity
passive1.text: After Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, Gaming will regain 1.5% of his Max HP once every 0.2s for 0.8s.

passive2.name: Air of Prosperity
passive2.text: When Gaming has less than 50% HP, he will receive a 20% Incoming Healing Bonus. When Gaming has 50% HP or more, Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider will deal 20% more DMG.

passive3.name: The Striding Beast
passive3.text: During the day (06:00 – 18:00), your party members gain the Swift Stride effect: Movement SPD increased by 10%. Does not take effect in Domains, Trounce Domains, or Spiral Abyss. Swift Stride does not stack.

c1.name: Bringer of Blessing
c1.text: When the Suanni Man Chai from Suanni's Gilded Dance meets back up with Gaming, it will heal 15% of Gaming's HP.

c2.name: Plum Blossoms Underfoot
c2.text: When Gaming receives healing and this instance of healing overflows, his ATK will be increased by 20% for 5s.

c3.name: Awakening Spirit
c3.text: Increases the Level of Bestial Ascent by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Soar Across Mountains
c4.text: When Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider hits an opponent, it will restore 2 Energy to Gaming. This effect can be triggered once every 0.2s.

c5.name: Evil-Daunting Roar
c5.text: Increases the Level of Suanni's Gilded Dance by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: To Tame All Beasts
c6.text: Bestial Ascent's Plunging Attack: Charmed Cloudstrider CRIT Rate increased by 20% and CRIT DMG increased by 40%, and its attack radius will be increased.

passive1.name: Undivided Heart
passive1.text: After firing a Frostflake Arrow, the CRIT Rate of subsequent Frostflake Arrows and their resulting bloom effects is increased by 20% for 5s.

passive2.name: Harmony Between Heaven and Earth
passive2.text: Celestial Shower grants a 20% Cryo DMG Bonus to active party members in the AoE.

passive3.name: Preserved for the Hunt
passive3.text: Refunds 15% of the ore used when crafting Bow-type weapons.

c1.name: Dew-Drinker
c1.text: Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrows or Frostflake Arrow Blooms decrease opponents' Cryo RES by 15% for 6s upon hit. A hit also regenerates 2 Energy for Ganyu. This effect can only occur once per Charge Level 2 Frostflake Arrow, regardless if Frostflake Arrow itself or its Bloom hits the target.

c2.name: The Auspicious
c2.text: Trail of the Qilin gains 1 additional charge.

c3.name: Cloud-Strider
c3.text: Increases the Level of Celestial Shower by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Westward Sojourn
c4.text: Opponents standing within the AoE of Celestial Shower take increased DMG. This effect strengthens over time. Increased DMG taken begins at 5% and increases by 5% every 3s, up to a maximum of 25%. The effect lingers for 3s after the opponent leaves the AoE.

c5.name: The Merciful
c5.text: Increases the Level of Trail of the Qilin by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: The Clement
c6.text: Using Trail of the Qilin causes the next Frostflake Arrow shot within 30s to not require charging.

passive1.name: Heedless of the Wind and Weather
passive1.text: After using Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, all nearby party members' DEF is increased by 25% for 12s.

passive2.name: A Favor Repaid
passive2.text: Gorou receives the following DMG Bonuses to his attacks based on his DEF: [' Inuzaka All-Round Defense: Skill DMG increased by 156% of DEF', ' Juuga: Forward Unto Victory: Skill DMG and Crystal Collapse DMG increased by 15.6% of DEF']

passive3.name: Seeker of Shinies
passive3.text: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Inazuma on the mini-map.

c1.name: Rushing Hound: Swift as the Wind
c1.text: When characters (other than Gorou) within the AoE of Gorou's General's War Banner or General's Glory deal Geo DMG to opponents, the CD of Gorou's Inuzaka All-Round Defense is decreased by 2s. This effect can occur once every 10s.

c2.name: Sitting Hound: Steady as a Clock
c2.text: While General's Glory is in effect, its duration is extended by 1s when a nearby active character obtains an Elemental Shard from a Crystallize reaction, or triggers a Lunar-Crystallize reaction. This effect can occur once every 0.1s. Max extension is 3s.

c3.name: Mauling Hound: Fierce as Fire
c3.text: Increases the Level of Inuzaka All-Round Defense by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Lapping Hound: Warm as Water
c4.text: When General's Glory is in the "Impregnable" or "Crunch" states, it will also heal active characters within its AoE by 50% of Gorou's own DEF every 1.5s.

c5.name: Striking Hound: Thunderous Force
c5.text: Increases the Level of Juuga: Forward Unto Victory by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Valiant Hound: Mountainous Fealty
c6.text: For 12s after using Inuzaka All-Round Defense or Juuga: Forward Unto Victory, increases the CRIT DMG of all nearby party members' Geo DMG based on the buff level of the skill's field at the time of use: [' "Standing Firm": +10%', ' "Impregnable": +20%', ' "Crunch": +40%'] This effect cannot stack and will take reference from the last instance of the effect that is triggered.

passive1.name: Flutter By
passive1.text: When a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife ends, all allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 8s.

passive2.name: Sanguine Rouge
passive2.text: When Hu Tao's HP is equal to or less than 50%, her Pyro DMG Bonus is increased by 33%.

passive3.name: The More the Merrier
passive3.text: When Hu Tao cooks a dish perfectly, she has an 18% chance to receive an additional "Suspicious" dish of the same type.

c1.name: Crimson Bouquet
c1.text: While in a Paramita Papilio state activated by Guide to Afterlife, Hu Tao's Charged Attacks do not consume Stamina.

c2.name: Ominous Rainfall
c2.text: Increases the Blood Blossom DMG by an amount equal to 10% of Hu Tao's Max HP at the time the effect is applied. Additionally, Spirit Soother will also apply the Blood Blossom effect.

c3.name: Lingering Carmine
c3.text: Increases the Level of Guide to Afterlife by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Garden of Eternal Rest
c4.text: Upon defeating an enemy affected by a Blood Blossom that Hu Tao applied herself, all nearby allies in the party (excluding Hu Tao herself) will have their CRIT Rate increased by 12% for 15s.

c5.name: Floral Incense
c5.text: Increases the Level of Spirit Soother by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Butterfly's Embrace
c6.text: Triggers when Hu Tao's HP drops below 25%, or when she suffers a lethal strike: Hu Tao will not fall as a result of the DMG sustained. Additionally, for the next 10s, her All Elemental and Physical RES is increased by 200%, her CRIT Rate is increased by 100%, and her resistance to interruption is greatly increased. This effect triggers automatically when Hu Tao has 1 HP left. Can only occur once every 60s.

params.5: Charged Attack & Swift Stormflight Stamina Cost

params.1: High Nightsoul Points ATK Conversion Rate
params.2: Low Nightsoul Points ATK Conversion Rate

passive1.name: Enhanced Resistance Training
passive1.text: After Swift Stormflight hits opponents, Iansan will gain the Precise Movement effect for 15s. During this time, her ATK is increased by 20%, and whenever she regains Nightsoul points through the Kinetic Energy Scale in her Elemental Burst, The Three Principles of Power, she will gain 1 extra Nightsoul point. Additionally, when your current active party member consumes or restores Nightsoul points, the extra Nightsoul points Iansan gains the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale will be increased to 4. This effect can occur once every 2.8s. "Precise Movement" will expire when Iansan's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

passive2.name: Kinetic Energy Gradient Test
passive2.text: When a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Iansan will obtain the Warming Up effect for 10s. During this time, when Iansan restores at least 1 Nightsoul point, she will heal your current active character for 60% of her ATK. This effect can be triggered once every 2.8s.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Hard Work and Drive
passive3.text: After Nightsoul points have been fully depleted and Iansan is on the field, she will switch to using Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing. While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Nightsoul Transmission: Iansan can be used. When the current active character is sprinting or in movement modes caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, switching to Iansan will trigger the following: Iansan enters the Nightsoul's Blessing state and obtains 25 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party. While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, Iansan will not take fall DMG when using terrain differences to make leaps.

c1.name: Starting's Never Easy
c1.text: When Iansan is in combat and is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, she will restore 15 Elemental Energy for every 6 Nightsoul points she consumes. This effect can trigger once every 18s.

c2.name: Laziness is the Enemy!
c2.text: When using the Elemental Burst The Three Principles of Power, Iansan will also gain the Precise Movement effect from her Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" for 15s. Additionally, if Iansan is off-field while Precise Movement is active, she will also increase your current active character's ATK by 30%. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Enhanced Resistance Training" to access the above effect.

c3.name: Scientific Diet Planning
c3.text: Increases the Level of Thunderbolt Rush by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Slow and Steady Wins the Race
c4.text: When the Kinetic Energy Scale is present, Iansan will gain 2 stacks of Surging Force after your current active character (excluding herself) uses their Elemental Burst. The stacks last until the Scale leaves the field, and Surging Force can be gained once per Scale summoning. Whenever Iansan restores Nightsoul points via the Scale, she will consume 1 Surging Force stack and restore 4 additional Nightsoul points. Additionally, if her Nightsoul restoration from the Scale overflows, Iansan will gain 50% of the overflow the next time she restores Nightsoul points via the Scale.

c5.name: We Can Push It Further!
c5.text: Increases the Level of The Three Principles of Power by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Teachings of the Collective of Plenty
c6.text: The Kinetic Energy Scale's duration is increased by 3s. Additionally, when Iansan triggers Nightsoul point restoration, if there is any overflow, she will gain the Extreme Force effect, which increases the DMG dealt by your current active character by 25% for 3s.

passive1.name: Field Medic's Vision
passive1.text: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every 1 Nightsoul point out of the current total in his entire party will grant him 1 Rescue Essentials point. Rescue Essentials will increase the Swirl, Stellar Swirl, Electro-Charged, and Lunar-Charged reaction DMG dealt by nearby party members.

passive2.name: Mutual Aid Agreement
passive2.text: When nearby party members trigger Nightsoul Bursts, Ifa's Elemental Mastery increases by 80 for 10s.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Focused Emergency Rescue
passive3.text: After his Nightsoul points are exhausted, Ifa will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain his Nightsoul's Blessing. While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Ifa. When the active character is a certain height in the air, the following will occur when switching to Ifa: Ifa will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and gain 32 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team.

c1.name: Vitiferous Elixir's Concoction
c1.text: When Supporting Fire hits an opponent, it will restore 6 Energy for Ifa. One such Energy restoration can be triggered once every 8s.

c2.name: Guiding Spirit of Ballistic Prayer
c2.text: When Ifa is in the Nightsoul's Blessing state, every Nightsoul point the party has above a total of 60 will grant Ifa 4 additional Rescue Essentials points. Additionally, Ifa's Rescue Essentials limit is increased by 50. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent Field Medic's Vision.

c3.name: Rebuttal in Negotiations With the Night
c3.text: Increases the Level of Airborne Disease Prevention by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Decayed Vessel's Permutation
c4.text: The restraining wind current created by the Elemental Burst Compound Sedation Field has its duration extended to 3s. Additionally, Ifa gains 100 Elemental Mastery for 15s after using his Elemental Burst Compound Sedation Field.

c5.name: Vow of Universal Coexistence
c5.text: Increases the Level of Compound Sedation Field by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Oath on a Feathered Knot
c6.text: When Ifa uses the Hold version of his Supporting Fire, there is a 50% chance that he will fire an additional Tonicshot that deals 120% of Ifa's ATK as Anemo DMG. This DMG is considered Normal Attack DMG. Additionally, when he is not in combat, Ifa will consume 20% less Nightsoul points and Phlogiston in his Nightsoul's Blessing state.

params.3: Nightingale's Song Stacks Gained from Elemental Burst
params.4: Nightingale's Song Stacks Gained from Geo Constructs

passive1.name: Torchforger's Covenant
passive1.text: After unleashing Elemental Skill Dawnbearing Songbird or Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection, other nearby party members will gain the Lightkeeper's Oath effect for 20s: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate increases by 5% and CRIT DMG increases by 10%. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam Party members affected by the Lightkeeper's Oath effect have their Elemental Mastery increased by 50.

passive2.name: Demonhunter's Dusk
passive2.text: Nightingale's Song's effects are enhanced: When there are 1/2/3 Hydro or Geo characters in the party, Nightingale's Song will further increase DMG. Increase in DMG is equal to 7%/14%/24% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery. If this aforementioned DMG is inflicted by a Lunar-Crystallize reaction, increase in DMG is equal to 48%/96%/160% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery.

passive3.name: Moonsign Benediction: Unwithering in Winter
passive3.text: When Illuga is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

c1.name: Vigilant Sentinel
c1.text: After Illuga triggers a Geo-related Reaction on the field, he will regain 12 Elemental Energy. This effect can be triggered at most once every 15s.

c2.name: Elk With Fanged Antlers
c2.text: When Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection's Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, for every 7 stacks of Nightingale's Song consumed, Illuga will summon Aedon, dealing a single instance of Geo DMG to 1 nearby opponent. The DMG dealt is based on 400% of Illuga's Elemental Mastery and 200% of his DEF. This DMG is considered Elemental Burst DMG.

c3.name: Earthshaking Maw
c3.text: Increases the Level of Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Solarhunting Wolf
c4.text: When Elemental Burst Shadowless Reflection's Haunted Night's Oriole-Song effect is active, nearby active party members will have their DEF increased by 200.

c5.name: Hurricane Steed
c5.text: Increases the Level of Elemental Skill Dawnbearing Songbird by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Nightmare Orioles
c6.text: Enhances the Lightkeeper's Oath effect of the Ascension Talent Torchforger's Covenant: For Geo DMG dealt to opponents, CRIT Rate is increased by 10%, CRIT DMG is increased by 30%. Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: When characters are affected by Lightkeeper's Oath, Elemental Mastery is increased by 80. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Torchforger's Covenant."

passive1.name: Overclocking Circuit
passive1.text: If there are thunderclouds created by Lunar-Charged reactions nearby when Birgitta unleashes Discharge attacks, she will initiate an additional attack, dealing AoE Electro DMG equal to 65% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG.

passive2.name: Panoramic Permutation Protocol
passive2.text: When using the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator, all your party members will gain the Parameter Permutation effect: Increases Ineffa and your own active party member's Elemental Mastery by 6% of Ineffa's ATK for 20s.

passive3.name: Moonsign Benediction: Assemblage Hub
passive3.text: When a party member triggers an Electro-Charged reaction, it will be converted into the Lunar-Charged reaction, with every 100 ATK that Ineffa has increasing Lunar-Charged's Base DMG by 0.7%, up to a maximum of 14%. Additionally, when Ineffa is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

c1.name: Rectifying Processor
c1.text: When Ineffa activates her Optical Flow Shield Barrier, all nearby party members will gain the Carrier Flow Composite effect for 20s: Increases Lunar-Charged DMG by 2.5% for every 100 ATK that Ineffa has, up to a maximum of 50%.

c2.name: Support Cleaning Module
c2.text: After the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator hits opponents, it will inflict the Punishment Edict status on one of those hit opponents: After a brief delay, or when this opponent is defeated, nearby opponents will take AoE Electro DMG equal to 300% of Ineffa's ATK. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. Additionally, when the Elemental Burst Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator is unleashed, nearby party members will gain Optical Flow Shield Barriers.

c3.name: Enhanced Emotion Emulator
c3.text: Increases the Level of Cleaning Mode: Carrier Frequency by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: The Edictless Path
c4.text: When your own party members trigger Lunar-Charged reactions, recover 5 Elemental Energy. This effect can occur once every 4s.

c5.name: Mirror's Dream Transcension
c5.text: Increases the Level of Supreme Instruction: Cyclonic Exterminator by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: A Dawning Morn for You
c6.text: When Ineffa is affected by the Carrier Flow Composite effect, she will deal AoE Electro DMG equal to 135% of her ATK to opponents in the current active character's vicinity after nearby thunderclouds release bursts of lightning at opponents. This DMG is considered Lunar-Charged DMG. The aforementioned effect can trigger once every 3.5s.

burst.name: Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter

passive1.name: Plan to Get Paid
passive1.text: When your team has at least one Pyro, Hydro, Electro, or Cryo character, the Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots from the Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter will be enhanced based on the number of characters of each corresponding element. Jahoda secretly keeps track of these characters. Among them, the element with the highest number of characters determines the enhancement effect: [' Pyro: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots deal 130% of their original DMG.', ' Hydro: Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots heal for 120% of their original healing amount.', ' Electro: The number of Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots increases by one.', ' Cryo: The attack interval of Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robots is reduced by 10%.'] If there's a tie between elements, the order of priority that determines which enhancement takes effect is: Pyro, Hydro, Electro, then Cryo. Only one elemental effect can initially be triggered.

passive2.name: Sweet Berry Bounty
passive2.text: When a Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot from the Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter triggers healing on an active team member, if that character's HP is above 70%, their Elemental Mastery will be increased by 100 for 6s.

passive3.name: Moonsign Benediction: Rooftop Dash
passive3.text: When Jahoda is in the party, the party's Moonsign will increase by 1 level.

c1.name: One More Flask!
c1.text: When a Fluffy Meowball fired by the Purr-loined Treasure Flask from the Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils hits an enemy, there is a 50% chance for it to bounce, dealing the corresponding Elemental DMG to nearby opponents.

c2.name: Rogue's Quick Thinking
c2.text: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: In the Ascension Talent "Plan to Get Paid," Jahoda can secretly track, in addition to the element with the highest number of characters, the element with the next highest number of characters among the remaining types. This allows up to two elemental effects to be active at once. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Plan to Get Paid."

c3.name: Desperate Gamble
c3.text: Increases the Level of Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Wild Berry Amid the Dust
c4.text: When a Purrsonal Coordinated Assistance Robot from the Elemental Burst Hidden Aces: Seven Tools of the Hunter undergoes an Elemental Conversion, Jahoda will recover 4 Elemental Energy.

c5.name: The Greatest Treasure
c5.text: Increases the Level of Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: The Littlest Luck
c6.text: Moonsign: Ascendant Gleam: After the Purr-loined Treasure Flask from the Elemental Skill Savvy Strategy: Splitting the Spoils is full, nearby Moonsign characters in your party have their CRIT Rate increased by 5% and CRIT DMG increased by 40% for 20s.

passive1.name: Wind Companion
passive1.text: On hit, Jean's Normal Attacks have a 50% chance to regenerate HP equal to 15% of Jean's ATK for all party members.

passive2.name: Let the Wind Lead
passive2.text: Using Dandelion Breeze will regenerate 20% of its Energy.

passive3.name: Guiding Breeze
passive3.text: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a dish with restorative effects, there is a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

c1.name: Spiraling Tempest
c1.text: Increases the pulling speed of Gale Blade after holding for more than 1s, and increases the DMG dealt by 40%.

c2.name: People's Aegis
c2.text: When Jean picks up an Elemental Orb/Particle, all party members have their Movement SPD and ATK SPD increased by 15% for 15s.

c3.name: When the West Wind Arises
c3.text: Increases the Level of Dandelion Breeze by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Lands of Dandelion
c4.text: Within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze, all opponents have their Anemo RES decreased by 40%.

c5.name: Outbursting Gust
c5.text: Increases the Level of Gale Blade by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Lion's Fang, Fair Protector of Mondstadt
c6.text: Incoming DMG is decreased by 35% within the Field created by Dandelion Breeze. Upon leaving the Dandelion Field, this effect lasts for 3 attacks or 10s.

passive1.name: Mountain Echoes
passive1.text: After nearby party members trigger a Nightsoul Burst, Kachina's Geo DMG Bonus increases by 20% for 12s.

passive2.name: The Weight of Stone
passive2.text: Turbo Twirly's DMG is increased by 20% of Kachina's DEF.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Heart of Unity
passive3.text: After her Nightsoul points are depleted, Kachina will switch to consuming Phlogiston to maintain her Nightsoul's Blessing. While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, she can use Nightsoul Transmission: Kachina. When the active character is currently sprinting, climbing, in a movement mode caused by certain Talents, or at a certain height in the air, the following will trigger when switching to Kachina: Kachina will enter the Nightsoul's Blessing state and ride Turbo Twirly when taking the field while gaining 30 Nightsoul points. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own team. Additionally, while in Natlan, Kachina will consume 90% less Stamina when climbing while riding Turbo Twirly.

c1.name: Shards Are Gems Too
c1.text: When Kachina mounts or dismounts Turbo Twirly, she will absorb nearby Elemental Shards created by Crystallize. Additionally, when a party member picks up such a Shard, or triggers Lunar-Crystallize reactions, 3 Energy will be restored to Kachina. Energy can be restored this way once every 5s.

c2.name: Never Leave Home Without... Turbo Twirly
c2.text: When Kachina uses "Time to Get Serious!", she will regain 20 Nightsoul points. If there is no Turbo Twirly belonging to her on the field, she will enter Nightsoul's Blessing and summon one.

c3.name: Improved Stabilizer
c3.text: Increases the Level of Go, Go Turbo Twirly! by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: More Foes, More Caution
c4.text: When there are 1/2/3/4 (or more) opponents within the Turbo Drill Field created by "Time to Get Serious!", the active character within the field gains 8%/12%/16%/20% increased DEF.

c5.name: All I've Collected Till Now
c5.text: Increases the Level of Time to Get Serious! by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: This Time, I've Gotta Win
c6.text: When your active character's Shield is replaced or destroyed for any reason, Kachina will deal 200% of her DEF as AoE Geo DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 5s.

passive1.name: Soumon Swordsmanship
passive1.text: If Chihayaburu comes into contact with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro when cast, this Chihayaburu will absorb that element and if Plunging Attack: Midare Ranzan is used before the effect expires, it will deal an additional 200% ATK of the absorbed elemental type as DMG. This will be considered Plunging Attack DMG. Elemental Absorption may only occur once per use of Chihayaburu.

passive2.name: Poetics of Fuubutsu
passive2.text: Upon triggering a Swirl or Stellar Swirl reaction, Kaedehara Kazuha will grant all party members a 0.04% Elemental DMG Bonus to the element absorbed by Swirl for every point of Elemental Mastery he has for 8s. Bonuses for different elements obtained through this method can co-exist.

passive3.name: Cloud Strider
passive3.text: Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%. Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

c1.name: Scarlet Hills
c1.text: Decreases Chihayaburu's CD by 10%. Using Kazuha Slash resets the CD of Chihayaburu.

c2.name: Yamaarashi Tailwind
c2.text: The Autumn Whirlwind field created by Kazuha Slash has the following effects: [" Increases Kaedehara Kazuha's own Elemental Mastery by 200 for its duration.", ' Increases the Elemental Mastery of characters within the field by 200.'] The Elemental Mastery-increasing effects of this Constellation do not stack.

c3.name: Maple Monogatari
c3.text: Increases the Level of Chihayaburu by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Oozora Genpou
c4.text: When Kaedehara Kazuha's Energy is lower than 45, he obtains the following effects: ['Pressing or Holding Chihayaburu regenerates 3 or 4 Energy for Kaedehara Kazuha, respectively.', 'When gliding, Kaedehara Kazuha regenerates 2 Energy per second.']

c5.name: Wisdom of Bansei
c5.text: Increases the Level of Kazuha Slash by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Crimson Momiji
c6.text: After using Chihayaburu or Kazuha Slash, Kaedehara Kazuha gains an Anemo Infusion for 5s. Additionally, each point of Elemental Mastery will increase the DMG dealt by Kaedehara Kazuha's Normal, Charged, and Plunging Attacks by 0.2%.

passive1.name: Cold-Blooded Strike
passive1.text: Every hit with Frostgnaw regenerates HP for Kaeya equal to 15% of his ATK.

passive2.name: Glacial Heart
passive2.text: Opponents Frozen by Frostgnaw will drop additional Elemental Particles. Frostgnaw may only produce a maximum of 2 additional Elemental Particles per use.

passive3.name: Hidden Strength
passive3.text: Decreases sprinting Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%. Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

c1.name: Excellent Blood
c1.text: The CRIT Rate of Kaeya's Normal and Charge Attacks against opponents affected by Cryo is increased by 15%.

c2.name: Never-Ending Performance
c2.text: While Glacial Waltz is in effect, for each opponent defeated, its duration is increased by 2.5s, up to a maximum of 15s.

c3.name: Dance of Frost
c3.text: Increases the Level of Frostgnaw by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Frozen Kiss
c4.text: Triggers automatically when Kaeya's HP falls below 20%: Creates a shield that absorbs damage equal to 30% of Kaeya's Max HP. Lasts for 20s. This shield absorbs Cryo DMG with 250% efficiency. Can only occur once every 60s.

c5.name: Frostbiting Embrace
c5.text: Increases the Level of Glacial Waltz by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Glacial Whirlwind
c6.text: Glacial Waltz will generate 1 additional icicle, and will regenerate 15 Energy when cast.

passive1.name: Amatsumi Kunitsumi Sanctification
passive1.text: After using Kamisato Art: Hyouka, Kamisato Ayaka's Normal and Charged Attacks deal 30% increased DMG for 6s.

passive2.name: Kanten Senmyou Blessing
passive2.text: When the Cryo application at the end of Kamisato Art: Senho hits an opponent, Kamisato Ayaka gains the following effects: ['Restores 10 Stamina', 'Gains 18% Cryo DMG Bonus for 10s.']

passive3.name: Fruits of Shinsa
passive3.text: When Ayaka crafts Weapon Ascension Materials, she has a 10% chance to receive double the product.

c1.name: Snowswept Sakura
c1.text: When Kamisato Ayaka's Normal or Charged Attacks deal Cryo DMG to opponents, it has a 50% chance of decreasing the CD of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 0.3s. This effect can occur once every 0.1s.

c2.name: Blizzard Blade Seki no To
c2.text: When casting Kamisato Art: Soumetsu, unleashes 2 smaller additional Frostflake Seki no To, each dealing 20% of the original storm's DMG.

c3.name: Frostbloom Kamifubuki
c3.text: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Soumetsu by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Ebb and Flow
c4.text: Opponents damaged by Kamisato Art: Soumetsu's Frostflake Seki no To will have their DEF decreased by 30% for 6s.

c5.name: Blossom Cloud Irutsuki
c5.text: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Hyouka by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Dance of Suigetsu
c6.text: Kamisato Ayaka gains Usurahi Butou every 10s, increasing her Charged Attack DMG by 298%. This buff will be cleared 0.5s after Ayaka's Charged ATK hits an opponent, after which the timer for this ability will restart.

passive1.name: Kamisato Art: Mine Wo Matoishi Kiyotaki
passive1.text: Kamisato Art: Kyouka has the following properties: ['After it is used, Kamisato Ayato will gain 2 Namisen stacks.', 'When the water illusion explodes, Ayato will gain a Namisen effect equal to the maximum number of stacks possible.']

passive2.name: Kamisato Art: Michiyuku Hagetsu
passive2.text: If Kamisato Ayato is not on the field and his Energy is less than 40, he will regenerate 2 Energy for himself every second.

passive3.name: Kamisato Art: Daily Cooking
passive3.text: When Ayato cooks a dish perfectly, he has an 18% chance to receive an additional "Suspicious" dish of the same type.

c1.name: Kyouka Fuushi
c1.text: Shunsuiken DMG is increased by 40% against opponents with 50% HP or less.

c2.name: World Source
c2.text: Namisen's maximum stack count is increased to 5. When Kamisato Ayato has at least 3 Namisen stacks, his Max HP is increased by 50%.

c3.name: To Admire the Flowers
c3.text: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Kyouka by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Endless Flow
c4.text: After using Kamisato Art: Suiyuu, all nearby party members will have 15% increased Normal Attack SPD for 15s.

c5.name: Bansui Ichiro
c5.text: Increases the Level of Kamisato Art: Suiyuu by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Boundless Origin
c6.text: After using Kamisato Art: Kyouka, Ayato's next Shunsuiken attack will create 2 extra Shunsuiken strikes when they hit opponents, each one dealing 450% of Ayato's ATK as DMG. Both these Shunsuiken attacks will not be affected by Namisen.

passive1.name: An Architect's Undertaking
passive1.text: When DMG dealt by a Dendro Core (including DMG from Burgeon and Hyperbloom) hits Kaveh, Kaveh will regain HP equal to 300% of his Elemental Mastery. This effect can be triggered once every 0.5s.

passive2.name: A Craftsman's Curious Conceptions
passive2.text: During Painted Dome, after Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents, his Elemental Mastery will increase by 25. This effect can be triggered once every 0.1s. Max 4 stacks. This effect will be canceled when Painted Dome's effects end.

passive3.name: The Art of Budgeting
passive3.text: When Kaveh crafts Landscape, Building, and Courtyard-type Furnishings, he has a 100% chance to refund a portion of the materials used.

c1.name: Sublime Salutations
c1.text: Within 3s after using Artistic Ingenuity, Kaveh's Dendro RES and Incoming Healing Bonus will be increased by 50% and 25% respectively.

c2.name: Grace of Royal Roads
c2.text: Kaveh's Normal Attack SPD increases by 15% during Painted Dome.

c3.name: Profferings of Dur Untash
c3.text: Increases the Level of Painted Dome by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Feast of Apadana
c4.text: Dendro Cores created from Bloom and Lunar-Bloom reactions Kaveh triggers will deal 60% more DMG when they burst.

c5.name: Treasures of Bonkhanak
c5.text: Increases the Level of Artistic Ingenuity by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Pairidaeza's Dreams
c6.text: When Kaveh's Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks hit opponents during Painted Dome, they will unleash Pairidaeza's Light upon the opponent's position, dealing 61.8% of Kaveh's ATK as AoE Dendro DMG and causing all Dendro Cores within that AoE to burst. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

passive1.name: Thundering Penance
passive1.text: After recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present, Keqing's weapon gains an Electro Infusion for 5s.

passive2.name: Aristocratic Dignity
passive2.text: When casting Starward Sword, Keqing's CRIT Rate is increased by 15%, and her Energy Recharge is increased by 15%. This effect lasts for 8s.

passive3.name: Land's Overseer
passive3.text: When dispatched on an expedition in Liyue, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

c1.name: Thundering Might
c1.text: Recasting Stellar Restoration while a Lightning Stiletto is present causes Keqing to deal 50% of her ATK as AoE Electro DMG at the start point and terminus of her Blink.

c2.name: Keen Extraction
c2.text: When Keqing's Normal and Charged Attacks hit opponents affected by Electro, they have a 50% chance of producing an Elemental Particle. This effect can only occur once every 5s.

c3.name: Foreseen Reformation
c3.text: Increases the Level of Starward Sword by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Attunement
c4.text: For 10s after Keqing triggers an Electro-related Elemental Reaction, her ATK is increased by 25%.

c5.name: Beckoning Stars
c5.text: Increases the Level of Stellar Restoration by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Tenacious Star
c6.text: When initiating a Normal Attack, a Charged Attack, Elemental Skill or Elemental Burst, Keqing gains a 6% Electro DMG Bonus for 8s. Effects triggered by Normal Attacks, Charged Attacks, Elemental Skills and Elemental Bursts are considered independent entities.

passive1.name: The Price of Desolation
passive1.text: When Kinich is in Nightsoul's Blessing state, opponents hit by his Elemental Skill will enter the Desolation state, and when affected by Burning or Burgeon reaction DMG, they will restore 7 Nightsoul points to him. Nightsoul points can be gained this way once every 0.8s. The Desolation state will persist until this instance of Kinich's Nightsoul's Blessing state ends.

passive2.name: Flame Spirit Pact
passive2.text: After a nearby party member triggers a Nightsoul Burst, Kinich will gain 1 stack of Hunter's Experience that lasts 15s. Max 2 stacks. When Kinich uses Canopy Hunter: Riding High's Scalespiker Cannon, all stacks of Hunter's Experience will be consumed, with each stack consumed increasing the DMG dealt by this Cannon shot by 320% of Kinich's ATK.

passive3.name: Night Realm's Gift: Repaid in Full
passive3.text: When Kinich is in the air following Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, he can consume 10 Phlogiston points to perform another mid-air swing. While in an area with Phlogiston Mechanics within Natlan, he can use Nightsoul Transmission: Kinich. When the current active character is sprinting, in movement states that result from specific Talents, or in the air, when you switch to Kinich: Kinich will perform one of the following actions depending on the conditions met: ['When facing a Coilgrass Sigil that can be interacted with: He will fire a grappling hook towards it to move;', 'When there are nearby opponents and you are in combat: Kinich will use Canopy Hunter: Riding High in the direction of the opponents;'] Otherwise, Kinich will fire a grappling hook and swing, prioritizing valid Coilgrass Sigils as grapple targets. Nightsoul Transmission can be triggered once every 10s by your own party. When interacting with Coilgrass Sigils and other items that Yumkasaurs can interact with, "Canopy Hunter: Riding High" will be converted to "Yumkasaur Mimesis," which causes interactions with such items to follow rules applicable to Yumkasaurs, and which will not put Canopy Hunter: Riding High on CD.

c1.name: Parrot's Beak
c1.text: After Kinich lands from Canopy Hunter: Riding High's mid-air swing, his Movement SPD will increase by 30% for 6s. Additionally, Scalespiker Cannon's CRIT DMG is increased by 100%.

c2.name: Tiger Beetle's Palm
c2.text: When Kinich's Elemental Skill hits an opponent, it will decrease their Dendro RES by 30% for 6s. Additionally, the first Scalespiker Cannon Kinich fires after entering Nightsoul's Blessing has increased AoE, and its DMG increases by 100%.

c3.name: Protosuchian's Claw
c3.text: Increases the Level of Canopy Hunter: Riding High by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Hummingbird's Feather
c4.text: When in Nightsoul's Blessing, Kinich will restore 5 Energy after using his Loop Shots or after unleashing the Scalespiker Cannon. Energy can be regenerated this way once every 2.8s. Additionally, Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord deals 70% more DMG.

c5.name: Howler Monkey's Tail
c5.text: Increases the Level of Hail to the Almighty Dragonlord by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Auspicious Beast's Shape
c6.text: After Scalespiker Cannon hits an opponent, it will bounce between opponents once, dealing 700% of Kinich's ATK as Dendro DMG. If this Scalespiker Cannon triggers the buffs that Ascension Talent "Flame Spirit Pact" or the Constellation "Tiger Beetle's Palm" grant to the Cannon, the bouncing attack will also obtain the relevant buffs.

passive1.name: Bewitching, Betwitching Tails
passive1.text: When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, each impact against an opponent will grant her a stack of Reinforced Packaging. This effect can be triggered once for each opponent hit every 0.5s. Max 3 stacks. When the Urgent Neko Parcel state ends, each stack of Reinforced Packaging will create 1 Shield of Safe Transport for Kirara. The shields that are created this way will have 20% of the DMG absorption that the Shield of Safe Transport produced by Meow-teor Kick would have. If Kirara is already protected by a Shield of Safe Transport created by Meow-teor Kick, its DMG absorption will stack with these shields and its duration will reset.

passive2.name: Pupillary Variance
passive2.text: Every 1,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will increase the DMG dealt by Meow-teor Kick by 0.4%, and the DMG dealt by Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 0.3%.

passive3.name: Cat's Creeping Carriage
passive3.text: When Kirara is in the party, animals who produce Fowl, Raw Meat, or Chilled Meat will not be startled when party members approach them.

c1.name: Material Circulation
c1.text: Every 8,000 Max HP Kirara possesses will cause her to create 1 extra Cat Grass Cardamom when she uses Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch. A maximum of 4 extra can be created this way.

c2.name: Perfectly Packaged
c2.text: When Kirara is in the Urgent Neko Parcel state of Meow-teor Kick, she will grant other party members she crashes into Critical Transport Shields. The DMG absorption of Critical Transport Shield is 40% of the maximum absorption Meow-teor Kick's normal Shields of Safe Transport are capable of, and will absorb Dendro DMG with 250% effectiveness. Critical Transport Shields last 12s and can be triggered once on each character every 10s.

c3.name: Universal Recognition
c3.text: Increases the Level of Meow-teor Kick by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Steed of Skanda
c4.text: After active character(s) protected by Shields of Safe Transport or Critical Transport Shields hit opponents with Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks, Kirara will perform a coordinated attack with them using Small Cat Grass Cardamoms, dealing 200% of her ATK as Dendro DMG. DMG dealt this way is considered Elemental Burst DMG. This effect can be triggered once every 3.8s. This CD is shared between all party members.

c5.name: A Thousand Miles in a Day
c5.text: Increases the Level of Secret Art: Surprise Dispatch by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Countless Sights to See
c6.text: All nearby party members gain a 12% All Elemental DMG Bonus for 15s after Kirara uses her Elemental Skill or Burst.

passive1.name: Pounding Surprise
passive1.text: When Jumpy Dumpty and Normal Attacks deal DMG, Klee has a 50% chance to obtain an Explosive Spark. This Explosive Spark is consumed by the next Charged Attack, which costs no Stamina and deals 50% increased DMG.

passive2.name: Sparkling Burst
passive2.text: When Klee's Charged Attack results in a CRIT Hit, all party members gain 2 Elemental Energy.

passive3.name: All Of My Treasures!
passive3.text: Displays the location of nearby resources unique to Mondstadt on the mini-map.

c1.name: Chained Reactions
c1.text: Attacks and Skills have a certain chance to summon sparks that bombard opponents, dealing DMG equal to 120% of Sparks 'n' Splash's DMG.

c2.name: Explosive Frags
c2.text: Being hit by Jumpy Dumpty's mines decreases opponents' DEF by 23% for 10s.

c3.name: Exquisite Compound
c3.text: Increases the Level of Jumpy Dumpty by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Sparkly Explosion
c4.text: If Klee leaves the field during the duration of Sparks 'n' Splash, her departure triggers an explosion that deals 555% of her ATK as AoE Pyro DMG.

c5.name: Nova Burst
c5.text: Increases the Level of Sparks 'n' Splash by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Blazing Delight
c6.text: While under the effects of Sparks 'n' Splash, Klee will regenerate 3 Energy for all members of the party (excluding Klee) every 3s. When Sparks 'n' Splash is used, all party members will gain a 10% Pyro DMG Bonus for 25s.

passive1.name: Immovable Will
passive1.text: While in the Crowfeather Cover state provided by Tengu Stormcall, Aimed Shot charge times are decreased by 60%.

passive2.name: Decorum
passive2.text: When Tengu Juurai: Ambush hits opponents, Kujou Sara will restore 1.2 Energy to all party members for every 100% Energy Recharge she has. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

passive3.name: Land Survey
passive3.text: When dispatched on an expedition in Inazuma, time consumed is reduced by 25%.

c1.name: Crow's Eye
c1.text: When Tengu Juurai grants characters ATK Bonuses or hits opponents, the CD of Tengu Stormcall is decreased by 1s. This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

c2.name: Dark Wings
c2.text: Unleashing Tengu Stormcall will leave a weaker Crowfeather at Kujou Sara's original position that will deal 30% of its original DMG.

c3.name: The War Within
c3.text: Increases the Level of Subjugation: Koukou Sendou by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: Conclusive Proof
c4.text: The number of Tengu Juurai: Stormcluster released by Subjugation: Koukou Sendou is increased to 6.

c5.name: Spellsinger
c5.text: Increases the Level of Tengu Stormcall by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: Sin of Pride
c6.text: The Electro DMG of characters who have had their ATK increased by Tengu Juurai has its CRIT DMG increased by 60%.

passive1.name: Breaking Free
passive1.text: When Shinobu's HP is not higher than 50%, her Healing Bonus is increased by 15%.

passive2.name: Heart's Repose
passive2.text: Sanctifying Ring's abilities will be boosted based on Shinobu's Elemental Mastery: ['Healing amount will be increased by 75% of Elemental Mastery.', 'DMG dealt is increased by 25% of Elemental Mastery.']

passive3.name: Protracted Prayers
passive3.text: Gains 25% more rewards when dispatched on an Inazuma Expedition for 20 hours.

c1.name: To Cloister Compassion
c1.text: Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite's AoE is increased by 50%.

c2.name: To Forsake Fortune
c2.text: Grass Ring of Sanctification's duration is increased by 3s.

c3.name: To Sequester Sorrow
c3.text: Increases the Level of Sanctifying Ring by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: To Sever Sealing
c4.text: When the Normal, Charged, or Plunging Attacks of the character affected by Shinobu's Grass Ring of Sanctification hit opponents, a Thundergrass Mark will land on the opponent's position and deal AoE Electro DMG based on 9.7% of Shinobu's Max HP. This effect can occur once every 5s.

c5.name: To Cease Courtesies
c5.text: Increases the Level of Gyoei Narukami Kariyama Rite by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: To Ward Weakness
c6.text: When Kuki Shinobu takes lethal DMG, this instance of DMG will not take her down. This effect will automatically trigger when her HP reaches 1 and will trigger once every 60s. When Shinobu's HP drops below 25%, she will gain 150 Elemental Mastery for 15s. This effect will trigger once every 60s.

passive1.name: Four Sealing Divination Charms
passive1.text: When the dash from the Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance hits a target, if it interacts with Hydro/Pyro/Cryo/Electro, the Swallow-Wisp Shield will undergo Elemental Absorption, with the converted shield absorbing DMG from the corresponding element with 250% efficiency. Additionally, if this use of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance causes the Swallow-Wisp Shield to undergo Elemental Absorption, the Feathermoon Rings that Lan Yan throws at her foes additionally deal Elemental DMG equal to 50% of the original in the corresponding Elemental Type. This DMG is considered Elemental Skill DMG.

passive2.name: Skyfeather Evil-Subduing Charm
passive2.text: The Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance and the Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise deal increased DMG equal to 309% and 774% of Lan Yan's Elemental Mastery respectively.

passive3.name: Thought and Intent, Like Silken Scent
passive3.text: When Lan Yan is in the party, your characters will not startle Crystalflies and certain other animals when getting near them. Check the "Other" sub-category of the "Living Beings / Wildlife" section in the Archive for creatures this skill works on.

c1.name: "As One Might Stride Betwixt the Clouds"
c1.text: After triggering the Elemental Absorption from the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms," this instance of Lan Yan's Elemental Skill Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance will produce another Feathermoon Ring when they are thrown at opponents. You must first unlock the Ascension Talent "Four Sealing Divination Charms."

c2.name: "Dance Vestments Billow Like Rainbow Jade"
c2.text: While the Swallow-Wisp Shield is active, when your active party member's Normal Attacks deal DMG, 40% of the Shield's DMG absorption will be restored, up to its original maximum absorption. This effect can occur once every 2s.

c3.name: "On White Wings Pierce Through Cloud and Fog"
c3.text: Increases the Level of Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c4.name: "With Drakefalcon's Blood-Pearls Adorned"
c4.text: After Lan Yan uses her Elemental Burst Lustrous Moonrise, the Elemental Mastery of all nearby party members increases by 60 for 12s.

c5.name: "Having Met You, My Heart is Gladdened"
c5.text: Increases the Level of Lustrous Moonrise by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

c6.name: "Let Us Away on Sylphic Wing, the Silvered Ornaments to Ring"
c6.text: Swallow-Wisp Pinion Dance gains 1 additional charge.
